text:
ci-bot: alert: nightly-bench detected small-batch tail latency +18% vs baseline for model rdx-small-v2 at commit 7b3f2a. run: https://ci.internal/bench/2332104321 :warning:

morgan: saw this, pinging @alek @kai — can someone grab the pprof/flamegraph and a run log?

alek: on it. which pool did it hit? i'm seeing alerts from gpu-pool-3 in the alert details.

kai: confirmed, 2 workers in gpu-pool-3 had the spike. low qps but long tails. suspicious: PR #4123 landed yesterday touching kv cache eviction heuristics.

sasha: I ran the local reproducer with nightly args — similar P99 bump for batch=4 seq=512. snippet:

```
$ ./bench --model rdx-small-v2 --batch 4 --seq 512 --pprof=cpu --runs 100
run 100/100: avg=24ms p95=78ms p99=159ms
baseline (prev commit): p99=132ms
```

alek: uploading flamegraph + pprof: https://artifacts.internal/fg/2332104321/alek-flame.svg and logs at https://artifacts.internal/logs/2332104321/alek.log

morgan: alek can you bisect 7b3f2a..e1c9f8 and just run small-batch with seq=512/batch=4? if too heavy just test the subset.

alek: starting bisect now, will iterate commits and post results ~30m. early hunch: kv eviction changes from #4123.

kai: i'll try a quick local revert of #4123 and run the same bench, should be faster than a full bisect.

triage-bot: note: marked incident sev3 — internal perf regression, SLOs not customer-facing but requires fast rollback if root cause confirmed.

sasha: also spotted memory churn in worker logs around the same window:

```
[2026-03-16T03:12:05Z] worker-07 GC: freed 120MB in 15ms
[2026-03-16T03:12:06Z] worker-07 alloc spike: +43MB
```

alek: bisect narrowed it down — commits around e1c9f8 to 7b3f2a. disabling kv eviction change locally returns p99 nearer baseline.

kai: confirmed on my machine: revert #4123 -> p99 back to baseline numbers. opening rollback PR now.

morgan: thanks. open rollback with the perf artifacts and a short note for release notes. if rollback merges, schedule a canary tomorrow morning and monitor the next nightly.

alek: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/inference/pull/4180 — rollback kv-evict-change, attached flamegraph + bench logs + repro steps.

sasha: :thumbsup: i'll add a nightly eval case to catch this pattern (small-batch seq=512 with kv churn) so it fails fast next time.

morgan: great work team — keep updates in this thread and add any follow-ups.
